Metadatos.descripcion: Manage your rentals and split utility bills among your tenants.

Inicio.lema: Your rentals in order, with bills split clearly.

Registro.subtitulo: Start managing your rentals in a minute.
Registro.contrasenaAyuda: At least {minimo} characters. A sentence you'll remember works great.
Registro.aceptoTerminos: I have read and accept the <privacidad>privacy policy</privacidad> and the <terminos>terms of use</terminos>.
Registro.googleAcepta: To continue with Google, first accept the privacy policy and the terms.
Registro.revisaEmail: We've sent an email to {email}. Click the link to confirm your account and get started.
Registro.revisaSpam: If you don't see it in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

Acceso.codigoAyuda: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Acceso.codigoRecuperacionAyuda: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works only once.
Acceso.usarRecuperacion: I don't have the app: use a recovery code
Acceso.verificacionReenviada: We've sent another confirmation email to {email}.
Acceso.contrasenaCambiada: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.

Recuperar.subtitulo: We'll send you a link to choose a new one.
Recuperar.enviado: If there is an account for {email}, we've sent you a link to change your password.
Recuperar.caduca: The link works once and expires in 1 hour. If you don't see it, check spam.

Restablecer.ayuda: At least {minimo} characters. Saving it will sign you out on all your devices.

Errores.emailSinVerificar: You haven't confirmed your email yet. Check your inbox.
Errores.demasiadosIntentos: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
Errores.terminos: There's no account for that Google account. To create one, sign up accepting the privacy policy and the terms.
Errores.enlaceNoValido: This link no longer works: it has been used or has expired.
Errores.sesionCaducada: Too much time has passed. Sign in again with your email and password.
Errores.cuentaNoVinculada: There's already an unconfirmed account with that email. Confirm it from the email we sent you and sign in with Google again.
Errores.generico: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

Panel.proximamente: Here you'll see your properties, payments and bills. We're getting it ready.

dobleFactor.explicacion: Besides your password, we'll ask for a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…) when you sign in.
dobleFactor.explicacionActivo: When you sign in with your password we also ask for the code from your authenticator app.
dobleFactor.soloGoogle: You sign in with Google: two-step verification is handled by your Google account.
dobleFactor.pedirContrasena: For your security, confirm your password.
dobleFactor.escanear: Scan this code with your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows.
dobleFactor.qrAlt: QR code to add Inquilinus to your authenticator app
dobleFactor.sinCamara: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
dobleFactor.guardaCodigos: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each one lets you sign in once. We won't show them again.
dobleFactor.archivoCodigos: Inquilinus recovery codes. Each one works only once.

sesiones.explicacion: If you've signed in on a device you no longer use or that isn't yours, sign out everywhere. You'll need to sign in here again too.

Legal.borrador: Text in preparation (version {version}). It will be available before the app opens to more people.
